bundle: one install entry, many small Cordis plugins. It det"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ects foreign package
formats, copies an explicitly selected package into profile-local storage, and
"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"materializes every supported capability as its own reversible DSH row. It does
not emulate another a"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"gent runtime or hide everything behind one universal
plugin."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Node.js 22.19 or newer is required. Install DSH first, then add the same Bridge

package. It carries the Web surface, the format adap"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ters, and MCP Apps support
through its own dependency graph."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Web"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Open **Settings → Plugins → Agent plugins** to scan local Codex, Claude Code,
and Pi state; register"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" or import marketplaces; search catalogs; install a
plugin; inspect per-plugin capability rows and d"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"iagnostics; and manage Pi
package update checks."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The Web panel is a management surface over the Host runtime. Closing the panel
does not stop install"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ed hooks, commands, skills, MCP servers, or Pi extensions."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### TUI"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"TUI does not need a second Bridge implementation. `/plugin-bridge`, imported
slash commands, and use"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"r-invocable skills are projected from the same Host

lifecycle stay on the Host and continue to work without a browser."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The screenshot comes from the

rendered only by the Web sandbox. The terminal do"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"es not execute browser UI."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Headless owner"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Pi extensions such as `pi-telegram` may require one live Session even when no

for that process lifecycle. Bridge still owns import, materialization, hooks,

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The layout follows DSH's standard plugin shape:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Package-owned wrapper entries are important under pnpm: the profile resolves

`<row>/"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"package.json` plus an exact-id browser bundle, so DSH's official

`@openma/dsh-mcp-apps` through two
independent package-owned wrappers. A Codex re"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"gistered App is the foreign-host

that connection and OAuth lifecycle."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Hook rows use the same dependency-wrapper pattern for DSH's official Codex and
